instruction:
Office Layout With Typed Material Export

This task starts from /home/user/Desktop/init.ifc and may use /home/user/Desktop/init_plan.png as a local reference image. Modify the provided office model and save the required outputs as /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc and /home/user/Desktop/result.csv.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc and /home/user/Desktop/result.csv; /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc is at least 500 bytes and /home/user/Desktop/result.csv is not empty.
2. /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema.
3. The IFC model contains exactly 1 IfcProject, 1 IfcSite, 1 IfcBuilding, 1 IfcBuildingStorey, 5 IfcSpace entities, 7 IfcWall entities, 1 IfcSlab, 4 IfcDoor entities, 3 IfcWindow entities, 7 IfcOpeningElement entities, 7 IfcRelVoidsElement relationships, 7 IfcRelFillsElement relationships, and 4 IfcMaterial entities.
4. The IFC model contains 0 IfcBuildingElementProxy, 0 IfcFurniture, 0 IfcRoof, 0 IfcColumn, 0 IfcBeam, 0 IfcStair, and 0 IfcFlowTerminal entities.
5. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique.
6. The single IfcBuildingStorey is named exactly Ground Floor, ignoring leading and trailing whitespace only.
7. The IfcSpace names are exactly Lobby, Office A, Office B, Meeting, and WC, ignoring leading and trailing whitespace only.
8. Lobby has clear plan dimensions 3.60 m by 2.80 m, Office A has 3.60 m by 6.40 m, Office B has 3.60 m by 9.40 m, Meeting has 3.40 m by 4.40 m, and WC has 3.40 m by 4.60 m; each may be in either X/Y orientation with tolerance +/-0.08 m.
9. Each IfcSpace has geometry height 2.80 m with tolerance +/-0.08 m.
10. The wall names are exactly Wall-S, Wall-N, Wall-W, Wall-E, Part-1, Part-2, and Part-3, ignoring leading and trailing whitespace only, with bounding-box dimensions 12.00 m by 0.20 m by 3.00 m, 12.00 m by 0.20 m by 3.00 m, 0.20 m by 10.00 m by 3.00 m, 0.20 m by 10.00 m by 3.00 m, 0.20 m by 9.60 m by 3.00 m, 0.20 m by 9.60 m by 3.00 m, and 3.80 m by 0.20 m by 3.00 m respectively, each in any axis order with tolerance +/-0.08 m.
11. The slab is named exactly Office Slab, ignoring leading and trailing whitespace only, and has bounding-box dimensions 12.00 m by 10.00 m by 0.20 m, in any axis order, with tolerance +/-0.08 m.
12. All spaces, walls, the slab, doors, and windows are spatially assigned to Ground Floor.
13. /home/user/Desktop/result.csv has exactly these headers in this order: GlobalId, Class, TypeName, MaterialSummary, NetArea, NetVolume.
14. /home/user/Desktop/result.csv has exactly 8 data rows, one row for the slab and one row for each wall, and each GlobalId matches that slab or wall in /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc.
15. The CSV row for Office Slab has Class IfcSlab, TypeName OfficeSlabType, MaterialSummary Concrete:0.200m, NetArea 120.0, and NetVolume 24.0.
16. The CSV rows for Wall-S, Wall-N, Wall-W, Wall-E, Part-1, Part-2, and Part-3 each have Class IfcWall, TypeName OfficeWallType, MaterialSummary Brick:0.120m | Insulation:0.050m | Gypsum:0.015m, and NetArea/NetVolume values 36.0/7.2, 36.0/7.2, 30.0/6.0, 30.0/6.0, 5.76/5.76, 5.76/5.76, and 2.28/2.28 respectively, each numeric value with tolerance +/-0.02.

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.
